questions.question:
Select the option that indicates the correct arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Flowers

2. Bees

3. Seeds

4. Nectar

5. Honey
questions.solution:
The correct sequence is as follows:

3. Seed -> 1. Flower -> 4. Nectar -> 2. Bees -> 5. Honey

Flower grows from seed, nectar comes out of flower, nectar is collected by bees and bees make honey.

So, the sequence will be '**3, 1, 4, 2, 5**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some rings are gold.

All gold is hot.

Some hot are red.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gold are rings.

II. Some hot are gold.

III. Some red are hot.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7443902943edbf6b2eb37d66afc6d2c88b9bf2d19c57b8cfecc1dd3a8ddac83c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some gold are rings→ Follow (As some rings are gold. As some part of rings is common with gold, therefore it is true.)

II. Some hot are gold → Follow (As all gold is hot. As whole gold comes in hot, therefore it is true.)

III. Some red are hot → Follow (As some hot are red. As some part of hot is common with red, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, All the conclusions follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All calculators are dustbins.

All complexes are dustbins.

Some adamants are cameras.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some calculators are complexes.

II. Some dustbins are calculators.

III. Some dustbins are adamants.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b00fd4b19d9c470fd0880f1eb8190701e9b091e3a7ff4a827f9d29fc64d1c0a1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some calculators are complexes→ Does not follow (As all calculators are dustbins and all complexes are dustbins. So it is possible but not true.)

II. Some dustbins are calculators → Follow (As all calculators are dustbins. As whole calculators comes in dustbins, therefore it is true.)

III. Some dustbins are adamants → **Does not f**ollow (As all calculators are dustbins, all complexes are dustbins and some adamants are cameras. As relation is given between dustbins and adamants, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"

⇒ 16 × 6 - __**12 **____**÷**____** 3**__ + 6 = ?

⇒ __**16 ×**____** 6**__ - 4 + 6 = ?

⇒ __**9**____**6 +**____** 6**__ - 4 = ?

⇒ __**102 - 4**__ = ?

⇒ **98 = ?**
